{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the revenue values for refunded orders
refunded_revenue_series = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'refunded']['revenue']

# Convert to float after removing commas
refunded_revenue_clean = refunded_revenue_series.str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check if any refunded order has non-zero revenue
non_zero_refunded_revenue = refunded_revenue_clean[refunded_revenue_clean > 0]

# Display the non-zero refunded revenue values
non_zero_refunded_revenue"}
